howto: Slide your finger or move the mouse (or hold the arrow keys) and the hole rolls toward it through the park.
Swallow objects smaller than the hole: cones, benches, trees, cars, vans and cottages drop in and it grows.
Objects with a red ring are too big for now: touching one chokes the hole and ends the run.
Eat all 12 small ones as fast as you can.
tips: Start with the tiniest objects: every bite makes the hole wider.
Objects near the hole get pulled into orbit, so you can reel them in from a short way off.
A red ring disappears once you have grown enough to swallow that object.
The camera pulls back as you grow; the 12 pips at the bottom count what you have eaten.
Your best time is the fastest full clear, shown top left.

controls.keyboard: Move the mouse or hold the arrow keys to steer; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold a finger on the screen and the hole rolls toward it; lift to stop. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy lets you swallow objects up to 1.5x your size and grows you faster; Hard only up to 1.15x with slower growth.

cheats.effect: Too-big objects bounce off instead of choking you
Objects get pulled in from twice as far

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or an arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the CHOKED! or COSMIC HOLE! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST clear time under the run timer, top left, and on the title screen
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated drag; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: CHOKED! card with objects eaten, or COSMIC HOLE! with clear time and best
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-hole-eater blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title screen (Low renders at 1x with no shadows, a shorter view, no skyline, trees or lamps and fewer particles; a CPU-rendered device starts on Low)
